nativeRoute: Reuse injected token, otherwise native POST /api/login with environment-injected userName/password → token HTTP header; browser only for interactive-only deployments

loginFlow.steps: 复用环境对应 token；缺失或 get_models 探针 result=10001 时，使用 FIRMWARE_MGR_USERNAME/PASSWORD（测试加 TEST_ 前缀）调用原生登录 API，取 data.token 并重新探针。脚本 scripts/query.py 仅在进程内保留 token，凭据不进入 argv/stdout/日志。失败不循环登录，探针成功但目标拒绝报告可能权限不足或 token 随后失效。只有缺少非交互认证能力或用户明确需要 UI 时才浏览器登录。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: token header（不是 Authorization Bearer）；Cookie 本身不足 API 认证；所有业务 POST JSON {}。
subjectPermission: POST /api/get_models 或 get_versions，result=0 是有效凭据/该读取权限；不能当稳定 subject 证明。get_user_info 既有 header/body bug 不能直接作探针。admin/developer/product 权限单独核验。
expiryRevoke: get_models result=10001 可在已有账号凭据下重新登录一次；新 token 探针失败即停止；探针成功后的接口拒绝不触发重新登录。expiry/revoke 和稳定 subject 待部署验证。

sources.contract: POST login JSON userName/password; success data.token; empty JSON API probe confirms missing userName; no real credential login

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.fixture: scripts/query.py offline unittest fixtures; not a real account login
verification.runtime: production frontend and unauthenticated empty-body route probe only; authenticated login and test deployment not verified
verification.scope: Authentication contract and helper fixtures only; no credential inspection, successful token issuance or business writes.
